description: This file implements a proxy observer system for managing multiple pipeline frame observers asynchronously, ensuring non-blocking behavior in a data processing pipeline. It defines classes to manage observer proxies and a main TaskObserver class that handles registering, deregistering, starting, stopping, and queuing frame events for multiple observers in an asyncio environment.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Holds queue, task, and observer instance for managing asynchronous processing of observer frames.

classes.name: TaskObserver
classes.description: A proxy observer that manages multiple user-defined observers, running their frame processing in parallel without blocking the pipeline.

methods.name: add_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Registers a new observer and creates a proxy for it if already started.

methods.name: remove_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Removes an observer and cancels its associated processing task.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Initializes and starts proxy tasks for all registered observers.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Stops all proxy observer tasks, cancelling their underlying asyncio tasks.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for all proxy observers.

methods.name: on_process_frame(self, data: FrameProcessed)
methods.description: Queues a frame processed event for all managed observers.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Queues a frame pushed event for all managed observers.

methods.name: Proxy _create_proxy(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Creates a proxy object (queue, task, observer) for a single observer.

methods.name: Dict[BaseObserver,Proxy] _create_proxies(self, observers: List[BaseObserver])
methods.description: Creates proxies for all observers in the list.

methods.name: _send_to_proxy(self, data: Any)
methods.description: Dispatches frame data to all proxy queues.

methods.name: _proxy_task_handler(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Asynchronous handler that processes frames for each observer.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, task_manager: BaseTaskManager, **kwargs, )

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, task_manager: BaseTaskManager, **kwargs, )

ctags.name: _proxy_task_handler
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _proxy_task_handler(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, observer: BaseObserver):$/
